assessment: Hage and colleagues used channelrhodopsin-mediated 2 photon stimulation combined with genetic labeling to survey the synaptic connections from layers 4, 5 and 6 onto layer 2/3 pyramidal neurons in the adult mouse primary visual cortex (V1). This work not only confirms prior knowledge regarding synaptic connectivity made through paired intracellular recordings, but also provides important new parameters and constraints about these connections. The results will contribute to our understanding of the cortical information processing.
